title: mentha longifolia subsp. hymalaiensis
intro: Mentha longifolia subsp. hymalaiensis, commonly known as Himalayan Pennyroyal, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce stress, and protect against oxidative damage. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia subsp. hymalaiensis include its ability to act as a carminative, reducing flatulence and gas, and its analgesic and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate pain and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, which are known for their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
